_comment: Analysis plan, committed BEFORE any val/test result was computed. The evaluation code reads these values; changing them after seeing results would be a protocol deviation and must be disclosed.

data.source: PTB-XL v1.0.3, lead II, 500 Hz records, first 10 s
data.split_policy: official PTB-XL strat_fold (tune folds 1-8, val fold 9, test fold 10), one record per patient
data.images: synthetic ECG-paper renderings of the digital signals (NOT photographs of real paper ECGs)
data.conditions: clean + 10 degradation families x {mild, severe} = 21 conditions (configs in src/ecgtrust/degrade.py)

unit_of_analysis: detected beat (candidate R peak) on the extracted signal

beat_error.definition: NRMSE_beat = RMSE(extracted - reference) over the beat window [R-200 ms, R+400 ms] after global DC+lag alignment, divided by robust record amplitude (P99-P1 of reference)
beat_error.unmatched_beats: detected beats with no reference beat within 100 ms are assigned error 1.0 (false detections are errors)

trust_scores.heuristic: equal-weight geometric mean of six evidence-group scores; anchors from tune split feature distributions only (no error labels)
trust_scores.learned: L2 logistic regression on raw features, trained on tune split, labels = bad_beat
trust_scores.operational_choice_rule: the score with the lower AURC on the VAL split becomes the operational score

threshold_rule.t_accept: lowest val threshold such that the bad-beat rate among beats scoring >= t is <= 5% (fallback: nothing accepted)
threshold_rule.t_reject: highest val threshold such that the bad-beat rate among beats scoring < t is >= 50% (fallback: nothing rejected)

baselines.image_quality: rank by global trace SNR (single basic image-quality statistic)
baselines.valid_fraction: rank by fraction of the beat window with valid samples

primary_endpoint.metric: AURC: mean over coverage of the average beat error among the top-coverage fraction ranked by trust (lower is better)
primary_endpoint.evaluated_on: TEST split only, pooled over all conditions, plus per-condition breakdown
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap over RECORDS (1000 resamples), paired across methods

hypotheses.H2: AURC(best simple baseline) - AURC(operational trust) > 0, 95% CI excludes 0

primary_endpoint.reporting_rule: report the outcome whatever it is; if H1 or H2 is not supported say so plainly

secondary: bad-beat rate and mean error at fixed coverage 0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7 / 0.6 / 0.5
error among accepted vs uncertain vs rejected vs all extractable beats at the operational thresholds
RR-interval and R-amplitude measurement error among accepted vs all beats
fraction of images unable to process, per condition
feature-group ablations of the heuristic score (re-render-only, drop-one-group)
known_limitations_declared_in_advance: synthetic renderings; the degradation mixture is chosen by the experimenters, so pooled numbers depend on it
the extractor and the renderer share a pixel grid model, which makes clean extraction easier than for real scans
single lead (II), single layout, 25 mm/s and 10 mm/mV assumed
